pixel_reduction.P_of_u: Solve original unique conditional P block with fixed 16 pixel fixed-point updates; original residual <=1e-4 retained.
pixel_reduction.C_j: mean over pixel cell of diag(P_fg)-P_fg P_fg^T, 3x3
pixel_reduction.finite_solve_caveat: T formula is exact for the conditional optimum; finite16 pixel updates make this an inexact Newton direction. Retain pixel residual and final primal-dual gap checks, never claim exact Newton from an approximate conditional solve.

joint_newton.variables: u and z updated together, not sequential stale best responses
joint_newton.D_R: diag((1/d)*(1+r^2/d)^(-3/2)); exact Hessian, not old IRLS gradient/r weight
joint_newton.gradient: Differentiate complete finite eight coupled steps under selected active faces. No source-zero early return that removes structural derivative. No simultaneous production switch to implicit gradients.
joint_newton.scalar_fixed_P_Schur: K=WD/(W+D), so D->infinity gives K->W rather than a stale block feedback near1
joint_newton.stable_algebra: Do not numerically form D-D(T+D)^(-1)D by large-number cancellation; use parallel-sum form.
joint_newton.occupancy_constraints: Primal-dual active set with per-cell nonnegative foreground and sum<=1. Active cell KKT/tangent blocks eliminate locally, leaving <=72-dimensional Schur system. Release active constraints according to multiplier/complementarity, not by current zeros alone.
joint_newton.projection_warning: T is full3x3. Existing diagonal weighted clamp/projection cannot silently be reused as the full-Hessian projection. Enumerate small faces / solve full-metric cell KKT.
joint_newton.active_constraint_conditioning: The bounded interior K formula does not automatically cover binding faces. Their correct reduced KKT and stable square-root/LDLT factorization must be checked separately.
joint_newton.line_search_rule: first feasible Armijo decrease candidate, c=1e-4, fixed original energy; if none qualifies STOP, no additional candidates/directions
joint_newton.guarantee: Not a proof eight Newton directions always converge; no acceptance without original residual gate and the additional gap certificate.

certificate.dual_variables: v arbitrary; s arbitrary for Q; |s_j|<=1/sqrt(d_j) for R
certificate.phi_R_conjugate: 1-sqrt(1-d_j*s_j^2), evaluate by rationalized equivalent near zero
certificate.dual_objective: D(v,s)=-mean_i logsumexp_c(log q_ic - lift(v)_ic) - [0.5 sum_j v_j^2/W_j + a0^T s + sum_j phi_j^*(s_j) + 0.5 ||F^T s||^2 + support_C(v-s)]/M; lift background coefficient0
certificate.construct_feasible_dual: v=W(AP-u), s=gradient of raw residual penalty; check dual feasibility explicitly, roundoff handled by fixed inward machine-precision mapping only if necessary and recorded.
certificate.gap: E(P,u,z)-D(v,s)>=0 for primal/dual feasible states; report raw and divided by max(1,|E|,|D|).
certificate.meaning: Bounds objective suboptimality independently of latent coordinate representation. Does not guarantee Dice or old-patient safety.
certificate.failure: Keep energy monotonicity and source identity gates; any residual/gap/feasibility failure STOP, do not silently substitute another solver.

qualification_before_medical.real_size: 384x384 full objective/backward must use real nonzero prior and nonzero synthetic adapter drift, not zero-factor proxy
qualification_before_medical.budget_screen: Worst-case fixed candidate and linear solve counts plus speed/memory estimate must fit original 8h/4GB before medical launch; failure ends proposal implementation attempt, no automatic iteration escalation

accepted step size, active face counts, linear-system relative residual
small spectral/conditioning summaries rather than guessed full condition number

private_problem_snapshot: current active faces and arithmetic dtype
failure_capture.rules: No image/label/patient ID snapshots, never public, never replay for training. Save on failure before re-raising. Budget approximately 20-50MB including atomic copy; preserve old failure records.

execution_if_later_authorized.source: fresh numerical/source gate for changed finite solver; N native saved rows remain reusable

execution_if_later_authorized.note: Candidate operation ceilings must be rebound to actual implementation, synthetic derivatives, active-set and line-search arithmetic. Higher algebra cost is not free and cannot borrow old V3 primitive buckets.
execution_if_later_authorized.binding_status: Fully bound by APOS_JOINT_V1_PROTOCOL_ZH.md and runtime.CAPS
